title: vLLM - UCM Pipeline Store (CI)
description: UCM observability dashboard - pipeline-store module. Part of a set; the other UCM dashboards (tag: ucm) are linked from the header. CI variant: fixed datasource uid 'prometheus', `job` selector at the top to switch between CI environments.

panels.description: Cache-stage hit rate from counter ratio: hits / (hits + misses). If low, most loads are descending into the Posix tier.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_hit_blocks_total{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/ clamp_min(
  sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_hit_blocks_total{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
  + sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_miss_blocks_total{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])),
  1
)

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate

panels.description: Fraction of load shards that missed the Cache buffer and had to descend to the backend (shard-level miss rate at load time). Equals rate(cache_load_backend_shards_total) / rate(cache_load_shards_total).

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_backend_shards_total{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/ clamp_min(
  sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_shards_total{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval])), 1
)

panels.title: Cache Backend Load Ratio

panels.description: Average end-to-end Cache load task duration. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Load Duration

panels.description: Average Cache load bandwidth. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker. Per-task observed throughput, sampled once per Cache stage task (one task = one start_load_kv / wait_for_save batch). Aggregates shards within a task but NOT across concurrent tasks. Use the (per worker) panel below for actual per-worker throughput.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_bandwidth_gbps_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_bandwidth_gbps_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Load Bandwidth (per task)

panels.description: Time a Cache load task spent waiting for the backend tier to fill the buffer. Large values mean frequent Cache misses or slow backend. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_backend_wait_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_load_backend_wait_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Load Backend Wait

panels.description: Cache load host-to-device copy duration on a synchronized stream. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_h2d_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_h2d_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache H2D Duration

panels.description: Average end-to-end Cache dump task duration. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_dump_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_dump_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Dump Duration

panels.description: Average Cache dump bandwidth. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker. Per-task observed throughput, sampled once per Cache stage task (one task = one start_load_kv / wait_for_save batch). Aggregates shards within a task but NOT across concurrent tasks. Use the (per worker) panel below for actual per-worker throughput.

targets.expr:

/

panels.title: Cache Dump Bandwidth (per task)

panels.description: Cache dump front-end split matching debug mk_buf/sync phases. mkbuf = prerequisite wait + buffer allocation/reuse + D2H async submit before stream sync; d2h = stream sync only. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg by selected view.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_dump_mkbuf_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_dump_mkbuf_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_d2h_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_d2h_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Dump MkBuf / D2H Duration

panels.description: Wall-clock per-worker Cache load throughput in GB/s. Aggregates all concurrent Cache load tasks inside one worker process and includes idle gaps, so this is the real bytes/sec the worker is pulling through the Cache stage. Pair with (per task) above: high per-task with low per-worker means tasks are fast but sparse.
panels.title: Cache Load Bandwidth (aggregated)

panels.description: Wall-clock per-worker Cache dump throughput in GB/s. Aggregates all concurrent Cache dump tasks inside one worker process and includes idle gaps, so this is the real bytes/sec the worker is pushing through the Cache stage. Pair with (per task) above: high per-task with low per-worker means tasks are fast but sparse.
panels.title: Cache Dump Bandwidth (aggregated)

panels.description: Posix-stage storage-to-host bandwidth (load direction). Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker. Per single-IO observed throughput, sampled once per shard transfer; does NOT aggregate across concurrent IO threads. Use the (per worker) panel below for actual disk throughput.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_s2h_bandwidth_gbps_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_s2h_bandwidth_gbps_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Posix S2H Bandwidth (per shard)

panels.description: Posix-stage host-to-storage bandwidth (dump direction). Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker. Per single-IO observed throughput, sampled once per shard transfer; does NOT aggregate across concurrent IO threads. Use the (per worker) panel below for actual disk throughput.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_h2s_bandwidth_gbps_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_h2s_bandwidth_gbps_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Posix H2S Bandwidth (per shard)

panels.description: Wall-clock per-worker load throughput in GB/s. Aggregates all concurrent IO threads inside one worker process and includes idle gaps, so this is the real bytes/sec the worker is pulling from posix. Pair with (per shard) above: if per-shard is high but per-worker is low, IO is fast but sparse — disk is not saturated.
panels.title: Posix S2H Bandwidth (aggregated)

panels.description: Wall-clock per-worker save throughput in GB/s. Aggregates all concurrent IO threads inside one worker process and includes idle gaps, so this is the real bytes/sec the worker is pushing to posix. Pair with (per shard) above: if per-shard is high but per-worker is low, IO is fast but sparse — disk is not saturated.
panels.title: Posix H2S Bandwidth (aggregated)

panels.description: Posix-stage S2H per-IO duration. Represents disk read latency. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_s2h_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_s2h_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Posix S2H Duration

panels.description: Posix-stage H2S per-IO duration. Represents disk write latency. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg, per worker.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_h2s_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_h2s_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Posix H2S Duration
Cache / Load Duration
panels.description: End-to-end Cache load task duration distribution. Bimodal here often indicates a mix of Cache hits (fast) and misses descending to Posix. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Cache / Load Bandwidth (per task)
panels.description: Effective Cache load bandwidth distribution. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated. Per-task observed throughput, sampled once per Cache stage task (one task = one start_load_kv / wait_for_save batch). Aggregates shards within a task but NOT across concurrent tasks. Use the (per worker) panel below for actual per-worker throughput.

panels.title: Cache / Dump Duration
panels.description: Caller-felt Cache dump duration. Watch for convergence with Posix h2s duration -- back-pressure signal (see perf doc §3.4). Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Cache / Dump Bandwidth (per task)
panels.description: Effective Cache dump bandwidth distribution. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated. Per-task observed throughput, sampled once per Cache stage task (one task = one start_load_kv / wait_for_save batch). Aggregates shards within a task but NOT across concurrent tasks. Use the (per worker) panel below for actual per-worker throughput.

panels.title: Cache / Load Backend Wait
panels.description: Time waiting for Posix to fill the buffer on a Cache miss. Spread and shift here drives total load latency. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Posix / S2H Duration
panels.description: Per-IO storage read latency distribution. Bimodal often = OS page cache hits vs cold reads. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Posix / H2S Duration
panels.description: Per-IO storage write latency distribution. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated.

panels.title: Posix / S2H Bandwidth (per shard)
panels.description: Storage read bandwidth distribution. Buckets are dense in 1-12 GB/s to resolve the typical operating range. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated. Per single-IO observed throughput, sampled once per shard transfer; does NOT aggregate across concurrent IO threads. Use the (per worker) panel below for actual disk throughput.

panels.title: Posix / H2S Bandwidth (per shard)
panels.description: Storage write bandwidth distribution. Buckets dense in 1-12 GB/s. Cell value is request rate from rate(bucket), not raw request count; all workers aggregated. Per single-IO observed throughput, sampled once per shard transfer; does NOT aggregate across concurrent IO threads. Use the (per worker) panel below for actual disk throughput.

Cache buffer lookup wall-clock time per `Lookup` / `LookupOnPrefix` call (fast path, in-memory hit/miss scan). Sub-millisecond is healthy; multi-millisecond means the scheduler is paying per-decision lookup overhead. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Lookup Duration

panels.description: Backend lookup time when descending due to no Cache buffer or buffer miss. Reflects the metadata-query latency of the lower tier (Posix / Ds3fs). Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_backend_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:cache_lookup_backend_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cache Lookup Backend Duration

panels.description: End-to-end Posix load task duration (submit → last shard finished). Compare with `cache_load_duration_ms`: the cache-vs-posix gap is the cache layer's H2D + stream sync overhead. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_load_task_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_load_task_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Posix Load Task Duration

panels.description: End-to-end Posix dump task duration (submit → last shard finished). Compare with `cache_dump_duration_ms`: the cache-vs-posix gap is the cache layer's D2H + dispatch serialization overhead. Series: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg.

targets.expr:
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_dump_task_duration_ms_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:posix_dump_task_duration_ms_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
